narrative.overview:
The site is a dark, grainy purple sheet with loud things printed on it. One fat headline per section, in rounded heavy capitals, carries the voice; a yellow word inside it is the one thing shouting. The work arrives as cream prints pinned to the sheet at a slight tilt, each with a vivid purple title, so projects read as objects rather than as rows of data. A hand-written script signs the page (the logo and the hero hello), and a ping-pong ball with eyes stands in for a letter of the hero's last word and follows the pointer.

The earlier Departures board is still underneath. Split-flap tiles remain the mechanical detail: codes, clocks, route stops, statuses, the toolkit timetable, the HELLO final call, the 404, the mobile menu and the case number all clatter in on tiles. A drafting grid (56px minor, 224px major) lies under everything and lights yellow in a soft circle around the pointer; thin line drawings of maths, tech and sports objects drift with scroll. A static film-grain layer sits over the whole page.

Separation is still mostly rules and hairlines. The few stroked shapes are thin, light outlines (the header bar, the ticker rail, the dashed empty slot), never heavy frames; the prints are filled cream, not bordered. Motion is soft and weighted: headline lines rise out of a blur, mixed-type words sharpen as they scroll into view, prints straighten on hover, and tiles still flip in 62ms half-turns.
keyCharacteristics: Bagel Fat One uppercase for every title and name; one or two words per title in signal yellow.
Cream prints (10px corners, slight tilt, long soft shadow) as the only filled cards, with purple titles.
Yellowtail script for the signature moments only: the logo and the hero hello.
Split-flap tiles for codes, numbers, clocks and statuses, never for titles.
Drafting grid that lights yellow around the pointer, line-drawn objects, and a static grain over everything.
Hairline rules for lists and facts; thin light outlines for the header, rail and empty slot.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: On the purple ground, yellow is the only accent. It marks the loud word, the live value and the action; everything else is paper, lilac or dim.

rules.name: The Print Rule
rules.body: Cream and purple belong together and only on prints (project cards and the case screenshot mount). Purple never sits on the dark board; cream never becomes a section background.

rules.name: The Fat Title Rule
rules.body: Every title and every name is Bagel Fat One uppercase. Nothing else on the page is set in it except the About quote and fact values.

rules.name: The Four Jobs Rule
rules.body: Display for titles and names, sans for sentences and bold caps UI, mono for data, codes, times and labels, condensed only inside tiles. Never set prose in display or mono.

rules.name: The Signature Rule
rules.body: Yellowtail appears only for the logo and the hero hello. It is a signature, not a heading style.

rules.name: The Only Prints Lift Rule
rules.body: Text, rows, tiles, buttons and the header carry no shadow. Prints, the toast and the terminal are the only lifted things, and every lift is long, soft and below the object.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: A single static grain layer (fractal noise at 9% opacity) covers the page above content. It never animates.

dos: Do set every title and name in Bagel Fat One uppercase, with one or two words in yellow.
Do present projects as cream prints with purple titles, 10px corners, a slight alternating tilt and the long soft print shadow.
Do keep split-flap tiles for codes, numbers, clocks, statuses and the HELLO and 404 boards.
Do use 10px corners for containers and buttons and 4px for the things inside them.
Do separate lists and facts with 1px hairlines (line or line-strong).
Do set data, codes, times and labels in Martian Mono uppercase at 11 to 12px with 0.12em tracking.
Do respect reduced motion: flips, blurs, rotations and tickers stop.
donts: Don't put purple on the dark board or use cream as a section background.
Don't introduce a second accent on the purple ground; status and emphasis stay yellow.
Don't draw heavy bordered boxes; outlines stay at 1.5 to 2px in line-strong and only on the header, rail and empty slot.
Don't put shadows on text, rows, tiles, buttons or the header.
Don't use Yellowtail for headings or Sofia Sans Extra Condensed outside tiles.
Don't set prose in the display face or in mono.
Don't draw fields as boxes; inputs are underlines.
